note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials. Reuse across daily runs. Template matches the 'Template Newsletter' draft (post_c0cde14a) and the current AI Current daily format.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222; text sections add data-color #FFFFFF; padding 20 for text/heading sections, 18 for section-image sections. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners (all four corners), data-width 100%. Story sections use h2 category headings (e.g. Business & Deals / Models & Enterprise AI / Policy & Governance), each preceded by a full-width abstract section image (no rounding) and followed by 1-2 story paragraphs with a bold lead sentence and a source link. Sign-off paragraph + 'Share AI Current' button ({{rp_referral_hub_url}}) at the end.
established_template.section_attrs: data-background-color=#222222 [data-color=#FFFFFF for text] data-padding-*=20 (text/heading) or 18 (section image) data-type=section class=node-section

ad_nodes.optional_attrs: data-advertisement-kind=primary|secondary (omit to let server pick); data-custom-intro=<=200 chars, no URLs
ad_nodes.placement_note: Placing an OFFER (numeric id from list_ad_offers) auto-accepts it and can fail with 'can not accept any more opportunities' when the acceptance cap is reached. ACCEPTED opportunities (uuid from list_ad_opportunities) embed without re-accepting, but fail if 'already placed in another post'. Create the post without ads first, then add ads via edit_post_content so one ad failure does not kill the whole draft.

recipients_note: Publication has no paid tiers (list_tiers=0). Send to free on web + email: recipients {web:{tier_ids:[free]}, email:{tier_ids:[free]}}.
